name: cron-system
effect: PERSISTENT: adds, replaces or removes /etc/cron.d/himmel-<tag>, a system cron job that runs on the schedule as root, with no arguments; the command is one executable under /usr/bin or /usr/sbin that root owns, reached through no symlink, with no group or other write on it or any directory above it; an operator-user job goes through cron-entry
